acceptance_criteria: The teach view and the camera test show the live camera picture while the camera runs, mirrored like a mirror, in a fixed-size area that does not move the controls
The detected hand points and the shoulders are drawn over the picture for each tracked frame, on the correct side of the mirrored picture
Nothing is stored or sent; the frames given to the tracker are unchanged and stay unflipped; the preview stops and is removed with the camera
Layout stays within the window at 360x640 and 640x360 with the preview shown

goal: While teaching and in the camera test, the caregiver sees the live camera picture with the detected hands drawn on it.
